newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close at record high ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close at record high ahead of weekend.

text.p: Dhaka stocks rose 3.75 percent to hit a record high ahead of the weekly market closure on Friday, brokers said.

The benchmark index of Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) rose 75.99 points to 2,101.16 on a turnover of 252.5 million taka. Of 105 issues traded, 72 rose and 33 fell. The previous record high of 2,095.33 was on October 7.

"The market sentiment improved greatly after investors overcame nervousness following recent restrictions on price movement," said one broker. Bangladesh Tobacco rose 30.95 taka to 347.95 and Beximco Pharma was up 20.32 at 232.
